about.title: Side by side
about.body: Beto Carrero World and Gravatá Beach are just minutes apart, and the inn sits right in between. Mornings at the park, afternoons by the sea. Back home, a comfortable suite, a generous breakfast and on-site parking.

official.question: Is the ticket official?
official.answer: Yes. Pousada Recanto do Park is an accredited Beto Carrero World agent and sells official tickets at the park's price.
official.answerPending: Yes. Tickets are official Beto Carrero World tickets at the same price as the park's website, and we handle everything for you on WhatsApp.

delivery.question: How do I receive and use my ticket?
delivery.answer: You get the e-ticket as a PDF. On the day, show it printed or on your phone at the entrance, with the photo ID used for the purchase.

kids.question: Do children pay?
kids.answer: Children up to 1 year and 11 months are free. From age 2 the full pass applies, following park rules.

optionals.question: Can I buy only the FastPass or the Ultrapass?
optionals.answer: No. Add-ons only work together with an entry pass for the same day.

withoutStay.question: Can I buy without staying at the guesthouse?
withoutStay.answer: Yes. You get the same service whether you stay with us or not.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy | Pousada Recanto do Park
privacy.metaDescription: How Pousada Recanto do Park handles your personal data and uses cookies, in line with Brazil's LGPD.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain terms, which personal data Pousada Recanto do Park receives, how we use it and what your rights are under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018).

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: This website belongs to Pousada Recanto do Park, located at {address}. For any matter about your data, contact us by email at {email} or on WhatsApp at {phone}.

sections.title: Data we receive
paragraphs: The website has no forms or sign-up. Personal data reaches us when you contact us on WhatsApp, by email or on Instagram, and may include:
items: stay dates and number of guests;
full name and photo ID, when you buy Beto Carrero World tickets, since tickets are issued in your name;

sections.title: How we use it
items: to reply to your messages and arrange your booking;
to issue and send Beto Carrero World tickets;
to meet legal obligations, such as guest registration.
sections.closing: We do not sell your data or use it for third-party advertising.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We only share what is needed to serve you:
items: Beto Carrero World, to issue the tickets you buy;
public authorities, when required by law.

sections.title: Cookies and third-party services
paragraphs: We use a functional cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers the language you chose.

We also use Google Tag Manager with the Google Ads tag, which sets advertising cookies to measure the results of our ads (for example, whether a visit came from an ad and led to a booking) and to show the inn's ads to people who have visited the website. This data is processed by Google under its privacy policy. You can adjust or turn off personalized ads at adssettings.google.com.
The map on the website is loaded by Google Maps, which may use its own cookies under Google's privacy policy. When you open the WhatsApp or Instagram links, those platforms' policies apply.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep data for as long as needed to handle your booking or purchase and to meet legal obligations. After that, it is deleted.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the LGPD, you may at any time:
items: confirm whether we process your data and access it;
request deletion of data we are not legally required to keep;
sections.closing: To exercise any of these rights, write to {email}. You may also contact Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: The website uses a secure connection (HTTPS), and access to the data we receive is limited to the people who need it to serve you.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated. The date at the top of the page shows the version in effect.

terms.metaTitle: Terms of Use | Pousada Recanto do Park
terms.metaDescription: Terms for using the Pousada Recanto do Park website, bookings and Beto Carrero World ticket sales.
terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms describe the conditions for using the Pousada Recanto do Park website. By browsing it, you agree to them.

sections.title: Website information
paragraphs: Photos, descriptions and amenities are meant to present the guesthouse and the region. Availability, prices and conditions are always confirmed when we reply on WhatsApp or by email.

sections.title: Bookings
paragraphs: The website does not make automatic bookings. A booking is only confirmed after we reply, with the dates, prices, payment and cancellation terms given at that time.

sections.title: Beto Carrero World tickets
items: Tickets are sold at the park's official price. The "from" prices shown on the website are a reference and change by batch and date; the final price is confirmed at purchase.
Tickets are issued in the buyer's name and follow Beto Carrero World rules, including use, date changes, refunds, minimum height for attractions and the need for an entry pass to use add-ons.
The park's operation, attractions and opening hours are the responsibility of Beto Carrero World.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The name, brand and texts of Pousada Recanto do Park may not be copied without permission. The Beto Carrero World brand and attraction names belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: External links
paragraphs: The website links to WhatsApp, Instagram, Google Maps and the Beto Carrero World website. These services have their own terms and policies, for which we are not responsible.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Brazilian law, including the Consumer Protection Code and the General Data Protection Law.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to {email} or on WhatsApp at {phone}.
